lines.line: Selected model is at capacity. Please try a different model.
There was a network issue connecting to the server, please try again.
lines.match: network issue connecting to the server
lines.carrier: print mode result with status ERROR and an empty response, vendor exit 1

lines.line: [agy] print timeout after <duration> with turn in progress; returning partial output
lines.match: with turn in progress; returning partial output
lines.carrier: the whole stderr line beginning `[agy] `, at any vendor exit, with or without a partial answer, which is never returned

lines.line: unexpected status 401 Unauthorized: Incorrect API key provided
lines.match: unexpected status 401 unauthorized: incorrect api key
lines.carrier: a codex `error` event message of a failed run; the key prefix that follows the sentence is never recorded
the `result` text of a print-mode JSON envelope with `is_error` true (api_error_status null)

lines.line: Error loading configuration: Your access token could not be refreshed because your refresh token was already used. Please log out and sign in again.
lines.match: please log out and sign in again
lines.carrier: a whole stderr line beginning `Error loading configuration:`, printed before any JSONL event
